title: "Be With Me"
description: On the lush world of Kloss, Rey chants "Be with me" as she meditates with BB-8 looking on from nearby. Hovering several feet above the ground, Rey sits in peace. The young Jedi levitates several rocks, much like Luke Skywalker before her in his own training. Rey loses focus, dropping the rocks and lowering herself to the forest floor.
